works.body:
Hi!
I would like to commission you an illustration for a song cover video.
It would be for the song "Rubia".

It would have my original character (reference: https://i.imgur.com/5Ygz0im.jpeg) in a similar composition to Fu Hua in this shot from the original scene: https://i.imgur.com/3NOZ28r.jpeg
Feel free to adjust the pose and background as you like!

- Please draw my original character with white hair and red tips / strands, like Fu Hua.
- Please draw her with red eyes instead of yellow
- Please draw her with clothes that look more similar to Fu Hua (I'll leave the details up to you)

I'd love if it could remind of the original emotions from the game!

Please make an image with 16:9 format.
Also, if you could send another version with transparent background, it would be great!

Thank you for reading my request.
Have a nice day!

https://imgur.com/a/wXID0QQ
I loved your recent Arknights art series! I'd like to see Reed and Eblana again but in your drip style.

Hello!

Can I please request an illustration of my character if you don't mind? If you can, I love to request to have a cool, cold look. I love your HSR Acheron illustration! I love a strong woman looks and the colours! https://x.com/SparksSummer465/status/1938905493004808385/photo/1 

Your artist impressions and ideas are all welcome. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18qrUMDzGcfubjWByoZlQQQ7MbFKBoO8Y

Hello Sparks! I adore your vibrant artstyle and wished to inquire, if I may request my original fox character Iris? She is usually a “big sister” type of character with a mature aura. I would love for her to wear a confident smirk while looking at the viewer. You may pick any of the outfits depicted within the references. If none of these are satisfactory, I'd love to see your own twist on what you think she would wear. You have complete creative freedom over how she's posed in the art. If possible, could you add flowers behind the character?

I hope you consider my request and I wish you a wonderful day!

(..◜ᴗ◝..)

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KH5Il2V2gPUnTP_Wpulm7oFut1fVUxht?usp=drive_link

Hello! I would like to request an artwork of my original character, Arin!
Notes:
- cat girl
- freckles along her nose
- red markings on her cheek
- ties her hair in a ponytail with a red ribbon
- uses a longsword (太刀)
- favourite food is mochi dango
I'm happy to leave the pose, outfit, and setting to you! It does not need to include her sword, or her favourite food, it's up to you if you want to include them.
Thank you!

Hi sensei,

Nice to meet you! I am lucky to have discovered one of your works for Entelechia (Arknights) on Twitter and I really love it, I would like to request a commission for my OC (FF14) if you are still open to new requests :D And I have selected an outfit that is more suitable to your creation style.

Here is some detail for her: 
- She's 169cm in height with good shape but it's not particularly exaggerated. 
- Her job is Viper, she acts gracefully and deadly. 
- Her weapon is a double saber which is able to combine as one or split as two parts, corresponding to her different battle styles. 
- She's able to control blood magic during combat.

 I would like to leave the details up to you. It's welcome for an amount adjustment. 

Thank you for considering!

https://imgur.com/a/skeb-viper-CSAWh5D

Hey! Always nice to meet another Hoyoverse fan 🙂

If you’re comfortable with it, I’d love if you drew Soldier 11 from Zenless Zone Zero. She’s my favorite and does not get enough love haha!

Happy to leave the details up to you, but if she could be blushing a little bit, that would be great. You can keep her in her original outfit though!

Thanks for considering my request, and I can’t wait to see the completed work! 🥰

Hi there~

I'd like to ask for another work of Rita Rossweisse. Specifically, I'd like to see a full-body art of Spina Astera Rita, complete with her weapon (Astral Divide). 

I'm not particularly picky, so I'll leave the specifics to you, but I'd like to see her in a combat/attacking pose. If it's not too much work some flame effects around her, but focused around the scythe blade.

Thanks for your consideration~

Hello again! I was very happy with your previous work of my character, so I'd like to request another with one of her other outfits.

Details:
-Confident and elegant demeanor
-I'd prefer if you followed the original outfit design rather than the replica shown in the game screenshots
-If possible, a relatively simple sky background like you've done a few times previously.  Could base it on this: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cuMx9BkGZpf1uPLTVEWfu_gQzS6CszSY/view?usp=sharing
-I'd like at least the brush portion of the weapon to be included.  You can simplify the effects if they're too much, though
-Exact pose, expression, and other details are up to you

Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zRLEZ6B_TC76LIrfeYFqYB0K9ymVaQGg?usp=sharing

hello! 

i would like to request my character in a combination of your 'drip style', with a couple of particular asks :D

my character: https://imgur.com/a/lkpOdtJ

she is always friendly, kind, and polite, despite a 'cool and sexy' look and outfit that can intimidate at first. the kind to always easily make new friends, no matter where she goes! 

i particularly love your recent Raiden set (https://bsky.app/profile/sparkssummer465.bsky.social), here I prefer the 'cute' eyes of GGZ, but.. perhaps you can combine elements of 'cute drip' like GGZ and 'casual-cool drip' of Genshin from that lineup.

in particular, i wish for her to have dj headphones around her neck as I am a dj myself. :D and if possible, i would also like the included hat, with her ears stick out somehow ~ 

thank you so much, i hope you will enjoy this request ^^

Thank you for your consideration.

Hi. I really like your artstyle so I want to make a commission on a character of a fighting game.

Character: Mai Natsume from BlazBlue
Cloth: With the coat in the reference
Pose: Crossed arms with her spare placed at behind her
Expression: I want her with a strong and firm with smile looking towards the camera (like ready to fight)
Background: up to your ideas (just not white since I want to use it as PC wallpaper so I do not want it to be bridge white)
Composition: showing 3/4 body (no trimming on head and clothing), landscape (as to be used as PC wallpaper)

I understand you mostly draw characters of Hoyogame so I hope you can consider my request.

https://imgur.com/a/reference-SR60Far

Hi there~
I really like your art of the Honkai Series, and was hoping to request something. 
In particular, I saw this work of the Raidens https://x.com/SparksSummer465/status/1821253335439323590 and wanted to commission something of a similar composition but featuring Rita across 6 portraits.

I'd like to see each featuring one of her core 5 battlesuits (Umbral Rose, Phantom Iron, Argent Knight: Artemis, Spina Astera, and Fallen Rosemary) and the 6th of her "Summer Night's Dream" outfit. I'll leave any specific pose details to you, but since they'll all be head-and-shoulders shots I'm not sure how much there is to pose. Maybe Umbral Rose is holding a teacup but aside that anything is fine.

I'm not sure if I've offered enough for a work of this style, so if it's not enough please request a resend with an amended amount!

Thanks for your consideration with this~

Hello again!
I loved the artwork you did for me so much, so I wanted to request another!

Here are reference images of her: https://imgur.com/a/MK18X6a

This is another Star Wars OC, her name is Meridia. She has lioness ears and tail.
She is love interest of Lilyth, and very good with blaster pistols as a weapon. Her personality is funloving and outgoing; she used to be aligned with the villains, though she is on the good side now. She is my friend's character and I wanted to give it to him as a birthday gift. 

Thank you very much!
